description:
Open an inline editable message compose form before sending to Slack. Use this when the user wants to write or send a Slack message so they can review and edit it first. Does NOT send directly — the form posts the message (via post_slack_message) when the user clicks Send.

PARAMETERS: target, text. For a direct message, target is the person: their user ID (U…) or email. The form shows their name and sends to their DM. A DM channel ID (D…) is refused, because it does not say who the message is for.

target.description: Where to send — channel ID (e.g., C1234567890), #channel-name (e.g., #general), or for a direct message the person's user ID (U…) or email

name: compose_slack_message
